blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Around P6.66-million worth of frozen chicken meat misdeclared as frozen tofu from Hong Kong was seized by the Bureau of Customs (BOC) at the port of Subic. According to the BOC, a 40-foot container was intercepted after an information report alleged that it may contain “frozen or processed food products and agricultural commodities” contrary to its declaration. READ: BOC: P47.4M smuggled agri-products blocked at Subic port The seized container was found carrying 1,380 cartons of frozen chicken breast and 174 cartons of frozen fish tofu.
